name: create_category
purpose: Propose a category the household does not have, flagged unreviewed for an admin to confirm or merge (ADR 0031, spec 0003 R13). The agent composes this (ADR 0042); the database refuses anything but an unreviewed expense category, so this tool cannot create an account of any other kind.

slug.description: Language-neutral, lowercase, hyphenated (ADR 0017) -- never a sentence and never an account name.
